description:
The server clock of ONE timed section in one attempt (IQ family, Phase 17.2).

Only for an attempt whose served sections ALL have `time_limit_seconds` (the
"timed sections" mode, app/delivery/CLAUDE.md). Sections run strictly in order:
a section's untimed intro starts when the previous one closed (the first: at
attempt start); "begin" (or the intro cap) starts its clock. A study section
shows its stimulus for `study_seconds` first, then the answering phase runs for
`time_limit_seconds`. Every time here is server time and never pauses (golden
rule #3). Phase at a moment `now`: no row -> pending; no `started_at` -> intro;
`now < study_ends_at` -> study; no `closed_at` -> answering; else closed.

answering_started_at.description: When answers became possible: started_at, or study_ends_at after a study phase (recorded once the study window is over).
answering_started_at.title: Answering Started At

deadline.description: started_at + study_seconds + time_limit_seconds, capped by the attempt deadline; fixed at begin.
deadline.title: Deadline

intro_started_at.description: When the section became current (its intro / samples screen).
intro_started_at.title: Intro Started At

position.description: 0-based order of the section in the attempt.
position.title: Position

started_at.description: Begin: the student's, or intro_started_at + intro cap.
started_at.title: Started At

study_started_at.description: = started_at for a section with a study phase.
study_started_at.title: Study Started At

title: AttemptSection
